recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three men in 1970s fashion arranged in a triangular formation against a solid sky-blue backdrop. The central figure kneels on an ornate Persian rug wearing red-and-white striped pants and a magenta shirt with dramatic floor-length fringe sleeves. Two men stand behind him, one in a white open-collar shirt and the other in a red short-sleeve shirt. The lighting is flat and even, typical of mid-century studio photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects creating a stable focal point
Contrast between the organic patterns of the rug and the flat blue background
Symmetry of the central figure's outstretched arms and fringe
Color coordination between the red shirts and the rug's warm tones
coreInvariants: Ornate patterned rug as the floor element
Central figure with horizontal arm extension and vertical fringe

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered horizontally; the kneeling figure occupies the lower-middle foreground, while the standing figures occupy the upper-middle background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The kneeling figure's face and the horizontal line created by his outstretched arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central kneeling figure, moves upward to the standing figures, then outward to the text blocks in the upper corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open blue space in the upper third and sides of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue (background) providing a cool, clean field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep reds and magentas (clothing and rug) providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white (shirt and pant stripes) for high-value highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a medium-value, low-saturation blue.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary reds, blues, and earthy rug tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with decorative internal patterns
letterConstructionRules: Internal horizontal hatching or 'inline' decorative texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with a fine-line geometric pattern rather than solid color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used for both artist and title to maintain 70s psychedelic-soul cohesion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of three men in 1970s soul attire. One man kneels in the center on an ornate Persian rug, wearing red-and-white vertical striped pants and a magenta shirt with long fringe hanging from the arms. Two men stand behind him, one in a white shirt and one in a red shirt. The background is a solid, flat sky-blue wall. Lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add decorative slab-serif text in the upper left and upper right corners. The text should have a heavy weight and an internal horizontal line pattern. Align the text in stacked blocks.

verificationChecks: Is the fringe on the central figure's arms prominent?
Is the rug pattern intricate and traditional?
Is the background a flat, seamless blue?
Is the text placed symmetrically in the upper corners?

adjustableVariables: Shade of blue for the background
mustRedesign: Specific record label logos in the bottom left
Exact facial features of the original subjects
Specific brand names or trademarked text

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color saturation

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the striped pants are vertical and high-waisted
Check that the fringe does not look like solid fabric
Verify the rug appears to be on a flat floor surface
Confirm the text has the specific internal hatching texture
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Studio Portrait + Triangular Grouping + Sky Blue Backdrop + Ornate Rug + Fringed Apparel + Decorative Slab Typography
